_about: Launch phase 1: features listed in 'hidden' are left out of the website (links, sections and pages). Remove a name to bring it back, then run npm run build. booking = online booking form (patients call, WhatsApp or email instead); accounts = My appointments and check-in pages; referrals = Refer a patient and partner log-in; home_visits = Doctor at your place; story_form = the Share your story form (stories stay readable).
